after.hourglass/timesheet.py:
# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet rows, one line per worker."""

from collections import Counter

from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes

def _check(shifts):
    if not shifts:
        raise ProjectError("no shifts given")
    if any(not shift.worker.strip() for shift in shifts):
        raise ProjectError("blank worker name")

def _line(name, counts, total):
    hours = total[name] / 60
    shifts = counts[name]
    return f"{name}: {shifts} shifts, {hours:.1f} hours"

# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts):
    _check(shifts)
    counts = Counter(shift.worker for shift in shifts)
    total = worker_minutes(shifts)
    names = sorted(total)
    names.sort(key=total.get, reverse=True)
    return [_line(name, counts, total) for name in names]
